_from: docs/plans/stories/PLAN.md. Story paintings for Gem Keep (The Keeper's Tale): one 1536x864 scene a page, filed as art/story/<story id>-<page>.webp. Crystal Night look (docs/prompts/gem-keep-art.md).

styles.a: Crystal Night: twilight in an enchanted fantasy land where glowing magic gems are the light, painterly storybook illustration, deep blues and purples with warm gem glows, friendly and cosy, for children aged 8 to 12, no blood, no gore, no romance, no text, no letters, no numbers.

pictures.name: gemkeep-opening-1
pictures.prompt: a small stone castle keep on a hill with glowing magic gems in its windows at the top of a twilight crystal valley, the gems lighting the green valley below. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-opening-2
pictures.prompt: a big grumpy grey-skinned goblin warlord with a muddy tusk, a dented iron crown and a tatty cape, funny not scary on a hilltop at dusk, rubbing his hands and looking towards a far valley that glows, his grey goblin horde gathering behind him. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-opening-3
pictures.prompt: A kind old keeper with a long white beard handing a big iron key to a young hero at the door of a glowing gem keep, twilight. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-chapter-1-1
pictures.prompt: small cartoon grey goblin soldiers of the Grey Horde, little sneaky scouts creeping up a twilight crystal valley with notebooks, counting towers. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-chapter-2-1
pictures.prompt: A sunny meadow at twilight with wooden barns full of dry golden hay, a nervous farmer watching a glowing red fire gem. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-chapter-3-1
pictures.prompt: An old wobbly wooden bridge over a winding river at twilight, creaking, a few planks missing. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-chapter-4-1
pictures.prompt: A rocky mountain pass at twilight, a pile of fallen rocks blocking a cave mouth that glows blue from inside. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-chapter-5-1
pictures.prompt: Families of villagers, grandparents, parents and children, hiding quietly behind trees in a twilight wood beside a long road. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-chapter-6-1
pictures.prompt: small cartoon grey goblin soldiers of the Grey Horde marching past a stone wall banging big drums, two rivers behind them, twilight. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-chapter-7-1
pictures.prompt: A frosty mountain ridge at twilight, big green spotted mushrooms frozen solid in blocks of ice. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-chapter-8-1
pictures.prompt: Two broken wooden castle gates side by side at twilight, gate-keepers with hammers looking at a small pile of wood. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-chapter-9-1
pictures.prompt: Stormy mountain peaks at night with lightning crackling between the clouds, glowing yellow gems sparking nervously. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-chapter-10-1
pictures.prompt: a big grumpy grey-skinned goblin warlord with a muddy tusk, a dented iron crown and a tatty cape, funny not scary leading his whole horde up to a small stone castle keep on a hill with glowing magic gems in its windows, the keep's old wall cracked, night. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-tale-1-1
pictures.prompt: a big grumpy grey-skinned goblin warlord with a muddy tusk, a dented iron crown and a tatty cape, funny not scary stamping his foot in a muddy camp, shouting at a blank notebook, cross goblin scouts with empty hands. Funny. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-tale-2-1
pictures.prompt: Happy farmers giving a big basket of strawberries to a young hero beside a barn full of hay, a bell on a post, twilight. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-tale-3-1
pictures.prompt: River otters fixing an old wooden bridge with sticks, goblin rafts stuck in the mud below, twilight. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-tale-4-1
pictures.prompt: Miners digging out a cave glowing with blue frost crystals, one holding up a crumpled note, twilight. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-tale-5-1
pictures.prompt: Families coming out of a twilight wood cheering, a grandad handing a young hero a curly horn. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-tale-6-1
pictures.prompt: small cartoon grey goblin soldiers of the Grey Horde dropping their drums on the ground and walking away home, looking at each other sheepishly. Funny. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-tale-7-1
pictures.prompt: Green spotted mushrooms waking up on a melting icy ridge and sneezing clouds of green dust at goblins running away. Funny. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-tale-8-1
pictures.prompt: Gate-keepers proudly finishing two mended wooden gates at twilight, a single road winding off to a glowing keep. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-tale-9-1
pictures.prompt: Two goblin bosses in tall metal helmets sliding down a snowy mountain on their shields, lightning above. Funny. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-tale-10-1
pictures.prompt: a big grumpy grey-skinned goblin warlord with a muddy tusk, a dented iron crown and a tatty cape, funny not scary staring up at a small stone castle keep on a hill with glowing magic gems in its windows with a cracked but standing wall, the gems glowing bright, night. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-ending-1
pictures.prompt: a big grumpy grey-skinned goblin warlord with a muddy tusk, a dented iron crown and a tatty cape, funny not scary sitting tired on a rock rubbing his sore feet, crown tipped sideways. Funny. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-ending-2
pictures.prompt: small cartoon grey goblin soldiers of the Grey Horde trudging home over the hills at sunrise carrying their packs, a few waving goodbye. Landscape, wide.

pictures.name: gemkeep-ending-3
pictures.prompt: A happy party in a twilight valley around a small stone castle keep on a hill with glowing magic gems in its windows, lanterns, music, a huge old book of keepers open on a table, the gems glowing brighter than ever. Landscape, wide.
